evals.prompt: Before I start modeling, show me the folder structure of this Jinkō project without changing anything.
evals.expected_output: Uses scripts/manage_folders.py without --create, explains that it lists all folders and renders a folders-only tree, and does not make a remote write.

evals.prompt: I need an Analysis folder at the project root. Please create it in my connected Jinkō project.
evals.expected_output: Confirms the target and explains that creation writes remotely before using scripts/manage_folders.py --create Analysis. It does not claim folder update, move, or delete support.

evals.prompt: Create a Figures folder inside my existing Results folder, then rename Results to Final Results.
evals.expected_output: Requests the resolved Results folder SID and confirmation before proposing child-folder creation. It identifies renaming as unsupported by the public folder API and does not invent an edit command.
